output:

---
title: "Mark-recapture Sampling of Adult Female Spectacled Eiders Breeding on Kigigak Island, Alaska: 2026 Section 10 Permit Annual Report"
author:
- name: Daniel Rizzolo and Sarah Hoepfner
  affiliation: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, University of Alaska Fairbanks
date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%B %d, %Y')`"
#output: html_document
output: pdf_document
---

```{r load-stuff, include=FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# update.packages(ask = FALSE, checkBuilt = TRUE)
# tinytex::tlmgr_update()
library(knitr) #to run rmarkdown
library(RODBC) # to load data tables from Access
library(ggplot2) # for plotting
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(tinytex) # output as PDF
# options(tinytex.verbose = TRUE)
library(dplyr)

# load relevant tables from Access
# specify database file (NB, RMarkdown sets directory with RMD file as the root directory when knit, thus the "../")
####2021####
db <- "C:/Users/shoepfner/Desktop/db_kig_nesting_waterfowl_2019-2026_compiled_20260923.accdb"

# connect to the Access database via RODBC package
con_db<-odbcConnectAccess2007(db)
# get list of data tables available in the Access database
sqlTables(con_db,tableType="TABLE")$TABLE_NAME
# load tables used in report
nest <- sqlFetch(con_db,"tbl_Nest")
band <- sqlFetch(con_db,"tbl_Band")
tdr <- sqlFetch(con_db,"tbl_TDR")
visit <- sqlFetch(con_db,"tbl_Visit")
resight <- sqlFetch(con_db,"tbl_Resight")
tissue <- sqlFetch(con_db,"tbl_TissueSamples")

# wrangle the nest data a bit
# subset to 2025 data only
nest$year <- format(nest$dt_found, format = "%Y")
nest <- subset(nest, year =="2021")
nest <- nest %>% filter(nest$cat_species == "SPEI")

# recode and consolidate nest fate categories 
nest$final_fate[nest$cat_fate == "active"] <- "active_lastcheck"
nest$final_fate[nest$cat_fate == "active_lastcheck"] <- "active_lastcheck"
nest$final_fate[nest$cat_fate == "eggs_abandoned"] <- "failed"
nest$final_fate[nest$cat_fate == "eggs_destroyed"] <- "failed"
nest$final_fate[nest$cat_fate == "eggs_missing"] <- "failed"
nest$final_fate[nest$cat_fate == "eggs_inviable"] <- "failed"
nest$final_fate[nest$cat_fate == "hatched"] <- "hatched"
nest$final_fate[nest$cat_fate == "not_monitored"] <- "not_monitored"

lyr_spei <- st_layers("~/2026 Kig post-field code/kig map files/plots_spei.kml") #Sarah's path

plots_spei <- sf::st_read("~/2026 Kig post-field code/kig map files/plots_spei.kml", quiet = FALSE)   #Sarah's path
crs_spei_plots <- "+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +no_defs +ellps=WGS84 +towgs84=0,0,0"

lyr_emgo <- sf::st_layers("~/2026 Kig post-field code/kig map files/plots_emgo_core.kml")
plots_emgo_core <- sf::st_read("~/2026 Kig post-field code/kig map files/plots_emgo_core.kml")


sf::gdal_utils("info",'~/2026 Kig post-field code/kig map files/kig_georef.tif') #kig image from Google Earth georeferenced in 
raster_kig <- terra::rast("~/2026 Kig post-field code/kig map files/kig_georef.tif")
names(raster_kig)

df_kig_2021 <- as.data.frame(raster_kig, xy=TRUE) # note 5 columns of georef'd values, but they are identical


# create Kig plot, but using aes to set the point aesthetics and permit making a legend
scale_label <- "Nest Fate"
p_2021 <- ggplot() +
  geom_raster(data = df_kig_2021, aes(x = x, y=y, fill = kig_georef_1)) + # Kig geotif
  scale_fill_gradient(low="black", high="white", guide = FALSE) + # kig image as b&w, guide FALSE prevents the legend
  #geom_polygon(data = plots_emgo_core, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group), color = "white", fill = "white", alpha = 0.0, linewidth = 0.25, linetype = "dotted") + # emgo plots
  geom_sf(data = plots_emgo_core, fill = NA, color = "white", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_sf(data = plots_spei, color = "white", fill = "white", alpha = 0.3) +
  #geom_polygon(data = plots_spei, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group), fill = "white", colour = "white", alpha =0.25, linewidth = 0.25)+ # spei plots
  geom_point(data = nest, aes(x = val_lon_nest, y = val_lat_nest, colour = as.factor(final_fate), shape = as.factor(final_fate)), size = 1.25)+ # nest locations, colored by fate
  scale_color_manual(values = c("green","red","green","blue"), scale_label, labels = c("active last check","failed", "hatched","not monitored"))+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(21,20,20,21), scale_label, labels = c("active last check","failed", "hatched","not monitored"))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(colour = "black", size = 6),
        axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black", size = 6),
        axis.title.x = element_text(colour = "black",size = 8),
        axis.title.y = element_text(colour = "black",size = 8),
        axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.25), #was 0.5
        #legend.title = element_text(size = 6),
        #legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
        panel.background = element_blank())+
  xlab("Longitude")+
  ylab("Latitude")+
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-165.03, -164.920), expand = c(0,0))+
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(60.815, 60.875), expand = c(0,0)) +
  ggtitle("2021")
p_2021

# decrease the size of the legend as per: https://stackoverflow.com/questions/52297978/decrease-overal-legend-size-elements-and-text 
addSmallLegend <- function(myPlot, pointSize = 1.0, textSize = 8, spaceLegend = 0.1) { #(myPlot, pointSize = 0.9, textSize = 6, spaceLegend = 0.1)
  myPlot +
    guides(shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = pointSize)),
           color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = pointSize))) +
    theme(legend.title = element_text(size = textSize), 
          legend.text  = element_text(size = textSize),
          legend.key.size = unit(spaceLegend, "lines"),
          legend.justification = c(1, 1), 
          legend.position = c(0.98, 0.98),#was 1,1
          panel.border=element_rect(colour="black", fill=NA, size=0.5))
}
#p
ggsave("nests_2021.png", plot = p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

nest$final_fate[nest$cat_fate == "eggs_destroyed"] <- "failed"

nest$final_fate[nest$cat_fate == "eggs_inviable"] <- "failed"
nest$final_fate[nest$cat_fate == "hatched"] <- "hatched"
nest$final_fate[nest$cat_fate == "not_monitored"] <- "not_monitored"

crs_spei_plots <- "+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +no_defs +ellps=WGS84 +towgs84=0,0,0"

lyr_emgo <- sf::st_layers("~/2026 Kig post-field code/kig map files/plots_emgo_core.kml")
plots_emgo_core <- sf::st_read("~/2026 Kig post-field code/kig map files/plots_emgo_core.kml")


sf::gdal_utils("info",'~/2026 Kig post-field code/kig map files/kig_georef.tif') #kig image from Google Earth georeferenced in 
raster_kig <- terra::rast("~/2026 Kig post-field code/kig map files/kig_georef.tif")
names(raster_kig)

df_kig_2025 <- as.data.frame(raster_kig, xy=TRUE) # note 5 columns of georef'd values, but they are identical


# create Kig plot, but using aes to set the point aesthetics and permit making a legend
scale_label <- "Nest Fate"
p_2025 <- ggplot() +
  geom_raster(data = df_kig_2025, aes(x = x, y=y, fill = kig_georef_1)) + # Kig geotif
  scale_fill_gradient(low="black", high="white", guide = FALSE) + # kig image as b&w, guide FALSE prevents the legend
  #geom_polygon(data = plots_emgo_core, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group), color = "white", fill = "white", alpha = 0.0, linewidth = 0.25, linetype = "dotted") + # emgo plots
  geom_sf(data = plots_emgo_core, fill = NA, color = "white", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_sf(data = plots_spei, color = "white", fill = "white", alpha = 0.3) +
  #geom_polygon(data = plots_spei, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group), fill = "white", colour = "white", alpha =0.25, linewidth = 0.25)+ # spei plots
  geom_point(data = nest, aes(x = val_lon_nest, y = val_lat_nest, colour = as.factor(final_fate), shape = as.factor(final_fate)), size = 1.25)+ # nest locations, colored by fate
  scale_color_manual(values = c("green","red","green","blue"), scale_label, labels = c("active last check","failed", "hatched","not monitored"))+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(21,20,20,21), scale_label, labels = c("active last check","failed", "hatched","not monitored"))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(colour = "black", size = 6),
        axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black", size = 6),
        axis.title.x = element_text(colour = "black",size = 8),
        axis.title.y = element_text(colour = "black",size = 8),
        axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.25), #was 0.5
        #legend.title = element_text(size = 6),
        #legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
        panel.background = element_blank())+
  xlab("Longitude")+
  ylab("Latitude")+
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-165.03, -164.920), expand = c(0,0))+
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(60.815, 60.875), expand = c(0,0)) +
  ggtitle("2025") 
p_2025

# decrease the size of the legend as per: https://stackoverflow.com/questions/52297978/decrease-overal-legend-size-elements-and-text 
addSmallLegend <- function(myPlot, pointSize = 1.0, textSize = 8, spaceLegend = 0.1) { #(myPlot, pointSize = 0.9, textSize = 6, spaceLegend = 0.1)
  myPlot +
    guides(shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = pointSize)),
           color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = pointSize))) +
    theme(legend.title = element_text(size = textSize), 
          legend.text  = element_text(size = textSize),
          legend.key.size = unit(spaceLegend, "lines"),
          legend.justification = c(1, 1), 
          legend.position = c(0.98, 0.98),#was 1,1
          panel.border=element_rect(colour="black", fill=NA, size=0.5))
}
#p
ggsave("nests_2025.png", plot = p_2025, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
p_2025
```
